description.narrative: The Initiative CASAMARINE 2 in de Aire Marine Protégée d’Ufoyaal Kassa-Bandial in Senegal implemented by Nebeday aims to consolidate the achievements and amplify the impacts obtained in 2023–2024 within the Ufoyaal-Kassa-Bandial (UKB) MPA, while extending certain innovations to the national level (spat collection on the Petite Côte and in Sine-Saloum). The strategy combines the protection of a priority area, the development of women's aquaculture sectors (oysters and mussels), energy transition at the household level, and the strengthening of scientific monitoring and local governance. The project directly targets 700 women (306 women already involved in the 3C cooperative, oyster/mussel farming groups that will join the cooperative, and women who will install improved stoves in their homes) . The key activities include Integrated management of the Eloubalir Priority Protection Zone (PPZ), Forest protection and energy transition, and Development of sustainable aquaculture and forestry sectors
